bio_en: Hovsep Tadevosian, known as Iosif Ivanich, was the son of Kristapor Mikaelian's sister and the brother of Samson and of Papasha (Levon Tadevosian). He held many responsible posts in the Armenian community of Iran and for a long time published the monthly 'Arpi' with a section for children and youth, as well as popular books on the French Revolution and Greek mythology. A year before his death he moved from Tehran to Geneva, where his son lived. He died there on 14 January at the age of 84.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death year derived from the Haratch issue number (7784, cf. no. 7794 dated 29 Jan 1957) and Alik 27th year; text gives age 84. Birth year therefore c.1873 - not stated.
